text:
Situation: Oxaliplatin 5 mg/mL, 10 mL vial inventory is low at Corvale Lakeside (8 vials, 8.6 days) while Corvale General holds 57 vials (20 days). The drug is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show oxaliplatin is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. FDA status is listed as "To Be Discontinued since -" with no date provided.

Our position: Internal redistribution can resolve the immediate imbalance at Lakeside without external purchasing. Alternate manufacturers Accord Healthcare Inc., Apotex Corp., BluePoint Laboratories, and Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. are not on the FDA shortage list, but their labels name no plant we could place, preventing procurement.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 6 vials of oxaliplatin 5 mg/mL, 10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside. Approval required: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. Monitor daily usage at both sites and re-evaluate inventory in 7 days. Approval required: Pharmacy Buyer.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Accord Healthcare Inc., Apotex Corp., BluePoint Laboratories, or Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. at this time due to inability to verify manufacturing site.
